key_insight: SUMNO turns a multigrid V-cycle into a U-shaped neural operator, achieving strong fluid-flow surrogate accuracy with 9.4 million parameters.
engineering_relevance: The architecture offers a parameter-efficient option for predicting steady and unsteady fluid flows on regular grids.
method: Spatially unrolls a V-cycle using parameter-free down/up-sampling and additive skips with normalization-free transfer pathways.
Uses convolutions at fine and intermediate resolutions and shifted-window attention at the coarsest resolution.
Generalizes attention window partitioning to support periodicity independently along each axis.
evidence_signal: Across four flow benchmarks and five baselines, SUMNO ranks first in 5 of 7 settings and second in two, reducing 10-step rollout MSE by about 30% versus the strongest baseline.
watch_item: The reported scope is regular-grid flow fields; applicability to irregular meshes and stability over longer rollouts remain unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: SUMNO: Spatially Unrolled Multigrid Neural Operator for Fluid Flow Surrogates
